name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
summary: A heavy hip-hinged row that builds the upper and mid back, lats and rear delts while training trunk strength.
setup: Stand with feet hip width and the bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips until the torso is roughly 30-45 degrees above horizontal and grip the bar just outside the knees.
Stand the bar up, brace the abs and keep the spine neutral with knees slightly bent.
execution: Pull the bar toward the lower ribs or upper stomach by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top without standing up.
Lower the bar under control until the arms are straight.
Keep the torso angle the same on every rep.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back: lighten the load and brace harder before each rep.
Standing up to heave the bar: keep the torso angle fixed and reduce the weight.
Pulling to the chest with flared elbows: pull to the lower ribs with elbows around 45 degrees.
Shortening the range: let the arms fully extend between reps.
